answer: A farm of clone keys collapses if each new seat must be cut at a unique altitude sample. The applicant reserves an 11-minute window, rides a winch to the marked zenith platform, and lets a sealed zephyr anemometer stamp a 40-second turbulence series onto a numbered quill card bound to the live address. Filing costs 0.33 POA plus a 19 POA bond locked for 15 epochs. Auditors re-run the card against the platform's public wind archive and the anemometer serial. A reused anemometer, a late arrival, or two cards sharing one serial seizes the bond and cancels both enrollments.
